name: WiMANS
summary: Dual-band WiFi CSI and synchronized video for simultaneous activities, locations, and occupancy from zero to five users.

settings.scenario: 0–5 simultaneous occupants performing activities at labeled locations; user_1…user_6 are annotation slots, not identity classes

standardization.notes: The official [T, 3 Tx, 3 Rx, 30 subcarriers] amplitude clip is transposed to [T, S, Tx, Rx]. Activity uses the 100 Hz, 3 s task view; all 30 subcarriers and all 3 × 3 antenna links stay native. The source sends at 1000 packets/s, and packet loss explains clips shorter than 3000 packets.
